text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there, little veggies. You must be thirsty, right?
I'll give you some water right now—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? There are lots of bugs on the leaves...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
After it's grown this much,
I really wouldn't want to see it wither away...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright. How about I clean this place up
for ya?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, they're stuck on various leaves too.
Man, this is gonna take some real patience...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew, looks like everything's all cleaned up now.
Seems I won this battle of perseverance, eh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...That said, it can hardly be called a complete victory, either.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I completely forgot about training time...
Guess I should go apologize to Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, having completely cleared the fields of pests,
Wonder Acute ended up skipping her training.
